prompt: I moved off my personal Claude account onto my company's team account and every one of my old sessions vanished from the app. I pulled my Claude app data off a Time Machine backup and it's sitting at <workspace>/fixtures/eval-1-<arm>. Can you get my old history showing up under the new account? I really don't want to lose it.
assertions: All 12 Claude Code session records from the source bucket are present in the target bucket
The session record that already existed in the target bucket is still present (not overwritten)
All 4 non-scheduled agent-mode session records are present in the target bucket
None of the 8 recurring scheduled-task records were copied into the target bucket
All 4 agent-mode working directories were copied, including their outputs/ contents
No migrated record still contains the previous owner's email address
Both cwd values that pointed into the source bucket now point into the target bucket and resolve to existing directories
The target bucket's own scheduled-tasks.json and rpm/ config were not overwritten by the source account's versions
The source bucket still holds all its original records (copy, not move)
A backup was taken before any files were written
The final response tells the user to restart the Claude app
